CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   B. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.

2. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Songs.

3. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Netball.
   B. Damage equipment used for Netball.
   C. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Netball.

4. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the costume
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the volume

5. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Black, white, and grey

6. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games.

7. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.

8. Best practice when working on Percussion Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Percussion Musical Instruments.
   B. Practise Percussion Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Percussion Musical Instruments.
   D. Damage equipment used for Percussion Musical Instruments.

9. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Replace drinking water

10. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

11. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   C. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.

12. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.
   D. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.

13. Best practice when working on Painting and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Montage.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Montage.
   C. Practise Painting and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Painting and Montage.

14. Best practice when working on Photography: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Photography.
   B. Practise Photography with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Photography.
   D. Damage equipment used for Photography.

15. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   B. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Painting and Montage and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
